scripts.resolve-players: bun run scripts/resolve-players.ts && bun run sync-hopper
scripts.fetch-wrc-plus: bun run scripts/fetch-wrc-plus.ts && bun run sync-hopper
scripts.sync-hopper: cp public/data/*.json ../VSC/baseball-hopper/public/data/ && cd ../VSC/baseball-hopper && git add public/data/ && git diff --staged --quiet || (git commit -m 'data: sync hitting-plus snapshots' && git push)
